extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: delivery van (high-roof panel van), approx. 5.6 x 2.3 x 2.5 m (L x W x H incl. mirrors), wheel diameter 0.72 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; sliding door (right side) is a separate object with origin at its front lower edge (move it about 1.1 m towards the rear, i.e. +Y, and 0.06 m outwards to open); 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no logo, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
